boxer

Build artifacts of boxer, addressed by content, and a demo of its apps running in a browser tab.

Demo

boxer apps compiled to WebAssembly and running in this tab, beside the Rust browser host (ADR-0263). The first visit downloads about 20 MB; the page loads nothing from any other site. Each app also opens in fresh, the light theme of ADR-0258; the theme is chosen when an app starts, so switching opens the app afresh.

  • Widget gallery The widget demos with their source. The map demos are left out, since they load tiles from a third-party server, and so are a few that do not run in a tab. light theme
  • IDS token catalogue The design-system tokens: neutral spine, semantic palette, type scale, colormaps. light theme
  • leeway widgets The leeway widgets over built-in fixtures. light theme
  • fibscope Fibonacci-tagged identifiers. light theme
  • splashscreen Build, version and licence notices. light theme

How a tab runs an app

Browser hosts by digest

tabhost/<sha256>.wasm is the Rust browser host a tab runs (ADR-0278). A module consuming boxer bundles its own apps and fetches the host its boxer pin records in browserhost.sum, without a Rust toolchain. tabhost/index.txt lists the published digests; nothing published is removed.
